['FCA Germany AG '].company_description: FCA Germany AG is a subsidiary of Stellantis, the company formed from the merger between FCA and PSA Group (Peugeot Société Anonyme) in 2021. It operates as a part of the Stellantis North America division, selling vehicles worldwide under the Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, and Ram nameplates, as well as distributing Alfa Romeo, Fiat, and Maserati vehicles in North America.

['T\u00dcV S\u00fcd AG'].company_description: TÜV Süd AG operates as an internationally active, independent service company that tests, inspects, and certifies technical systems, facilities, and objects to minimize hazards and prevent damages. It is part of the TÜV SÜD group, which is one of the three large holding companies along with TÜV Nord and TÜV Rheinland. The company is involved in testing, inspecting, and certifying a wide range of technical systems and objects to ensure safety and quality.
